# Asset Loader Third-Party Sources

These headers are vendored for the authored asset pipeline.

## cgltf

- File: `cgltf.h`
- Source: https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf
- Retrieved from: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf/master/cgltf.h
- License: MIT. See the license text at the top of `cgltf.h`.
- Use: glTF 2.0 and GLB parsing.

## stb_image

- File: `stb_image.h`
- Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb
- Retrieved from: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nothings/stb/master/stb_image.h
- License: public domain or MIT. See the license text at the top of
  `stb_image.h`.
- Use: PNG image decoding for externally referenced model textures.
